put.summary: Change a runtime setting; takes effect immediately
Toggle mail polling and autopilot at runtime

post.summary: Human action; returns the updated session
Store our OpenAI key on the 5U gateway

get.summary: All tariff versions, review queue first
Dashboard KPIs; hourly series over the last `hours` hours
Live board, most recently active first
Summary, RFQ, price candidates, bids and booking
All mails of the session, oldest first
Pending outbound mail waiting for a human, or 404
Mailbox, newest first; q is a full-text search
LLM calls, newest first, without prompt/response
One LLM call with request and response
Raw JSON payload of one event
Gateway key status, live switches and env safety flags

LiveUpdate.description: Only the fields that are present are changed.

openAiKeyRegistered.description: Whether the 5U gateway holds our OpenAI key; null if unknown

openAiKeyLast4.description: Last four characters of the stored key, as reported by 5U

openAiKeyCheckedAt.description: When 5U last checked the stored key (ISO-8601)

autopilot.description: Runtime setting autopilot: answer live mails automatically

SessionAction.description:
A human action on a session. `body` is required for edit_and_send, `type` (a MailType) for reroute,
`note` is optional for resolve.

type.description: reroute: MailType for the session's latest inbound mail

SessionSummary.description: One row of the live board. Read from the denormalized session table only.

boardVerdict.description: accepted | rejected | pending | open | no answer | voided

Stats.description: Dashboard KPIs. Totals are all-time, hourly covers the requested window.

medianResponseSeconds.description: First quote mail out minus the RFQ mail in

statusCounts.description: Every SessionStatus is present, zero when unused

ActiveShipment.description: A booked or confirmed shipment with airport coordinates, for the globe.

Rfq.description: Shipment request extracted from the customer's mail.

MailDetail.description: MailSummary plus body, threading headers and attachment metadata.

EventItem.description: Audit trail entry without its payload; load the payload lazily via getEventPayload.

Draft.description: Outbound mail waiting for a human (needs_human or autopilot off).

BoardResult.description: Our result for one request on the 5U board (cached from /v1/board/me).

verdict.description: accepted | rejected | pending | open | no answer | voided
